Hi Zhong-wen,

OK so it seems the integrator isn't able to balance the energy/mass budget of the soil with those settings with the default error tolerance (i.e., how close to zero the energy/mass balance gets to when it's integrating). It does need a certain spacing of soil nodes to work properly, so avoiding big departures from the default settings is a good idea. ERR=2 is still pretty good so if that works, it might be fine. 

But a better solution would be to do two simulations that give you all the depths you need. It may be that having no nodes between 69cm and 2m is the problem, so you could try removing one shallow node, say 12 cm, and add 150cm, and see if that works. Plot the results, esp. the near soil temps and the soil moisture and snow, to see how much of a difference it's making to the calculations, compared to upping the ERR value. I'd avoid going higher than 2.5. 

You could add a trycatch so that if it hits trouble it increases ERR until a threshold of 2.5. Below is an example of some code I wrote for doing lots of sites and catching errors, which you could adapt to your situation (note it also checks if there's available future climate, which isn't always the case, and saves the DEM data for the site if it hasn't been done before, since that is always the same and it takes time if you're having to rerun sites):

  for(jj in 2000:2000){
    ystart <- jj
    yfinish <- ystart

Hi Zhong-wen,

OK so it seems the integrator isn't able to balance the energy/mass budget of the soil with those settings with the default error tolerance (i.e., how close to zero the energy/mass balance gets to when it's integrating). It does need a certain spacing of soil nodes to work properly, so avoiding big departures from the default settings is a good idea. ERR=2 is still pretty good so if that works, it might be fine. 

But a better solution would be to do two simulations that give you all the depths you need. It may be that having no nodes between 69cm and 2m is the problem, so you could try removing one shallow node, say 12 cm, and add 150cm, and see if that works. Plot the results, esp. the near soil temps and the soil moisture and snow, to see how much of a difference it's making to the calculations, compared to upping the ERR value. I'd avoid going higher than 2.5. 

You could add a trycatch so that if it hits trouble it increases ERR until a threshold of 2.5. Below is an example of some code I wrote for doing lots of sites and catching errors, which you could adapt to your situation (note it also checks if there's available future climate, which isn't always the case, and saves the DEM data for the site if it hasn't been done before, since that is always the same and it takes time if you're having to rerun sites):

  for(jj in 2000:2000){
    ystart <- jj
    yfinish <- ystart
    scenario <- 2
   
    nyears <- yfinish - ystart + 1
   
    microdir <- paste0(outdir, 'micro/', ystart, '_', scenario)
    if(!dir.exists(microdir)){
      dir.create(microdir)
    }
   
    # micro parameters
    REFL <- 0.2
    Usrhyt <- 0.8
   
    for(ii in 1:nrow(longlats2)){
      loc <- c(longlats2$lng[ii], longlats2$lat[ii])
      citynum <- longlats2$num[ii]
      if(!file.exists(paste0(microdir, '/micro_', citynum, '.Rda'))){
        # set initial conditions
       
        if(!file.exists(paste0(outdir, 'dem/dem_', citynum , '.Rda'))){
          dem <- NULL
          attempt <- 0
          while( is.null(dem) && attempt <= 30 ) {
            attempt <- attempt + 1
            try(
              dem <- microclima::get_dem(lat = loc[2], long = loc[1], resolution = 30, xdims = 100, ydims = 100) # mercator equal area projection
            )
            elevera5 <- microclima::get_dem(r = NA, lat = loc[2], long = loc[1], resolution = 10000, xdims = 10, ydims = 10)
            lar <- round(loc[2] * 4, 0)/4
            lor <- round(loc[1] * 4, 0)/4
            e <- extent(lor - 0.875, lor + 0.875, lar - 0.875, lar + 0.875)
            e5d <- projectRaster(elevera5, crs = sf::st_crs(4326)$wkt)
            rte <- raster(e)
            res(rte) <- 0.25
            e5d <- resample(e5d, rte)
            xy <- data.frame(x = loc[1], y = loc[2])
            weather.elev <- raster::extract(e5d, xy)
          }
          save(dem, file = paste0(outdir, 'dem/dem_', citynum , '.Rda'))
          save(weather.elev, file = paste0(outdir, 'dem/weather.elev_', citynum , '.Rda'))
          temploc <- tempdir()
        }
       
        load(paste0(outdir, 'dem/dem_', citynum , '.Rda'))
        load(paste0(outdir, 'dem/weather.elev_', citynum , '.Rda'))
       
        # run microclimate model
        ERR <- 1.5
        continue <- TRUE
        if(scenario != 0){
          terra_source = "http://thredds.northwestknowledge.net:8080/thredds/dodsC/TERRACLIMATE_ALL/data"
          nyears <- yfinish - ystart + 1
          if(yfinish > 2015){
            ystart_terra <- 2015 - nyears + 1
            yfinish_terra <- 2015
            message(paste0("terraclimate climate change scenarios are for 1985 to 2015 - using ", ystart, "-", yfinish), '\n')
          }else{
            ystart_terra <- ystart
            yfinish_terra <- yfinish
          }
          tryCatch(                       # Applying tryCatch
           
            expr = {                      # Specifying expression
              terra <- as.data.frame(get_terra(x = loc, ystart = ystart_terra, yfinish = yfinish_terra, source = terra_source))
              message("Everything was fine.")
            },
           
            error = function(e){          # Specifying error message
              message("There was an error message.")
            },
           
            warning = function(w){        # Specifying warning message
              message("There was a warning message.")
              continue <<-FALSE
            },
           
            finally = {                   # Specifying final message
              message("tryCatch is finished.")
            }
          )
        }
        if (continue) {
          micro <- micro_era5_local(terra_source = terra_source, dem = dem, fail = 5, ERR = ERR, slope = 0, loc = loc, dstart = paste0('01/01/', ystart-1), dfinish = paste0('31/12/', yfinish), Usrhyt = Usrhyt, REFL = REFL, spatial = '/ERA5/time', scenario = scenario, weather.elev = weather.elev, runshade = 0)
          gc()
          while(min(micro$metout[,1])==0 & ERR <= 3){
            cat("model crashed, trying a higher error tolerance \n")
            ERR <- ERR + 0.25
            micro <- micro_era5_local(terra_source = terra_source, dem = dem, fail = 5, ERR = ERR, slope = 0, loc = loc, dstart = paste0('01/01/', ystart-1), dfinish = paste0('31/12/', yfinish), Usrhyt = Usrhyt, REFL = REFL, spatial = '/ERA5/time', scenario = scenario, weather.elev = weather.elev, runshade = 0)
            gc()
          }
          if(min(micro$metout[,1])>0){
            dni <- micro$microclima.out$hourlydata$rad_dni
            dif <- micro$microclima.out$hourlydata$rad_dif
            diffuse_frac <- dif / (dif + dni)
            diffuse_frac[is.na(micro$diffuse_frac)] <- 1
            #micro <- list(metout = micro$metout, soil = micro$soil, microclima.out = micro$microclima.out, diffuse_frac = diffuse_frac, REFL = micro$REFL, elev = micro$elev)
            micro <- list(metout = micro$metout, soil = micro$soil, diffuse_frac = diffuse_frac, REFL = micro$REFL, elev = micro$elev)
            save(micro, file = paste0(microdir, '/micro_', citynum, '.Rda'))
          }
          temploc <- tempdir()
          #unlink(temploc, recursive = TRUE)
          file.remove(list.files(temploc, include.dirs = TRUE, full.names = TRUE))
        }
      }
    }
